entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Earlier on 27th June, 2023 petitioners prayed for liberty to file supplementary affidavit enclosing the documents under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Accordingly, in presence of the learned advocate, date was fixed on 18th July, 2023.

Today, when the matter has been called, learned advocate, appears and submits that he is unable to file supplementary affidavit enclosing the documents under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedures as his clients have been suffering ailments.
I have scrutinized the contentions advanced in the revisional application which relate to charge-sheet submitted in connection with Penro Police Station Case No.84 of 2021 dated 17.07.2021.

entities.text: Penro Police Station Case No.84 of 2021
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Charge-sheet in this case was filed on 30th August, 2021 under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
As the revisional application is not enclosed along with the documents under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the opinion and its foundation is not transparent before this Court.
The brief facts narrated by the Investigating Agency do make prima facie offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

However, the petitioners would be at liberty to take out an application under Section 239 of the Code of Criminal Procedure before the jurisdictional Magistrate after receipt of the copies under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Learned jurisdictional Magistrate would consider the same in accordance with law without being influenced by any observations made by this Court while disposing of the present revisional application.
With the aforesaid observations, CRR 311 of 2023 is disposed of.
